AMORTIZED_EARNED.note: 5 exact base balances; CLM ACCDEPOSITPFT only via verified CLS link

UNEARNED_PROFIT.note: 2 exact base balances; distinct component, never deducted from or added to the legacy carrying amount

LOAN_FEES.note: Ethix Loan_Fees_QAR. No T24 fee source, balance identifiers, sign or overlap treatment supplied. Never zero-filled.

SUSPENSE_SP.note: Table 11 row 25 SP-suffixed list. Separate metric; SP codes are not aliases of base codes.

ETHIX_LOAN_CARRYING_AMOUNT.note: Ehab's Outstanding_QAR + Amortized_Earned_QAR + Loan_Fees_QAR (seven cells, five asset rows). Unavailable until every component is available.

PL_PERIOD_MOVEMENT.note: Income/expense rows (CONSOLIDATE.PRFT.LOSS). Period/YTD movement logic; never a loan closing-stock measure.

CLOSING_STOCK.description: Signed closing balance per contract/balance type at the reporting date.

PERIOD_MOVEMENT_YTD.description: Profit-and-loss period or year-to-date movement. Separate adapter required once CONSOLIDATE.PRFT.LOSS fields and period conventions are supplied.

ecb_adapter.field_source: UNCONFIRMED: names taken from workbook specification text, not from the bank's ECB schema
ecb_adapter.owner_excluded_balance_types_note: Balance types the owner has explicitly decided are outside these loan metrics. Any other unlisted type on a selected contract is an UNCLASSIFIED exception that blocks that contract's totals.
ecb_adapter.sparse_zero_convention_note: null means a missing balance type is missing, never zero. To approve a convention, set {"approved_by":..., "approved_on":..., "applies_to":"BASE_TYPES"}.

currency.note: Amounts stay in contract currency. No FX conversion is performed; local-currency equivalents need an approved rate source and date.

maturity.note: Proposed replacement for 'System Date - MATURITY.DATE'. Intervals are inclusive integer-day ranges and must be mutually exclusive and complete from 0 upward. Matured/overdue and missing maturity are separate states requiring owner disposition. 'Without Maturity' (column D) is not assumed to equal missing maturity.

credit_quality.risk_grade_source: UNCONFIRMED: CUSTOMER L.INT.RISK.RT per Table 11 text; risk feed conventions require review
credit_quality.balance_metric_note: Risk grade selects the column; the balance component (metric) is chosen independently and identically for every grade once the owner approves it.
